name: Set-Theoretic Obfuscation
description: Replaces the graph-theoretic concept of an odd cycle (or counting internal edges) with a strict set-theoretic equation ($L_1 \cup L_2 \cup L_3 = V$). This forces models to algebraically deduce that the three distinct sets of size 2 must be the exact pairs of the triad, preventing surface-level pattern-matching to standard triangle-finding algorithms unless they complete this logical deduction.
